package managed

// Compiled ONLY inside a tracked historical source export by the Python driver.
// All state is synthetic. No server, backend, Docker, SSH, or pier I/O is used.
// synctest fixes time; rand.Reader fixes IDs before original code persists them.
import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"

	"git.thechristophgroup.org/thelifeandtimes/omabit/internal/access"
	"git.thechristophgroup.org/thelifeandtimes/omabit/internal/pierstore"
	"git.thechristophgroup.org/thelifeandtimes/omabit/internal/protocol"
	"git.thechristophgroup.org/thelifeandtimes/omabit/internal/routines"
	"git.thechristophgroup.org/thelifeandtimes/omabit/internal/runtimequalify"
)

type g02Random struct { n uint64 }
func (r *g02Random) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	for i := range p {
		block := sha256.Sum256([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("G02 synthetic random %d", r.n/32)))
		p[i] = block[r.n%32]
		r.n++
	}
	return len(p), nil
}

func TestG02GenerateHistorical(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("G02_OUTPUT_DIR") == "" { t.Fatal("use scripts/test-historical-upgrades.py") }
	synctest.Test(t, g02Generate)
}

func g02Generate(t *testing.T) {
	check := func(err error) { t.Helper(); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) } }
	old := rand.Reader
	rand.Reader = &g02Random{}
	defer func() { rand.Reader = old }()
	dir := os.Getenv("G02_OUTPUT_DIR")
	check(os.Mkdir(filepath.Join(dir, "state"), 0700))
	s, err := openStore(filepath.Join(dir, "state"))
	check(err)
	defer s.close()
	s.portAvailable = func(string, uint16) bool { return true }
	s.mode = DevelopmentMode
	/*STORAGE_VALIDATOR*/
	var schema int
	check(s.db.QueryRow("PRAGMA user_version").Scan(&schema))
	if schema != /*SCHEMA*/ { t.Fatalf("original writer produced schema %d", schema) }

	// Public keys are generated from a documented, non-secret test-only seed.
	seed := sha256.Sum256([]byte("G02 PUBLIC SYNTHETIC SIGNING SEED; NEVER USE"))
	private := ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(seed[:])
	public := private.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey)
	wire := make([]byte, 51)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(wire, 11)
	copy(wire[4:], "ssh-ed25519")
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(wire[15:], 32)
	copy(wire[19:], public)
	publine := "ssh-ed25519 " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(wire)
	grant, err := access.AuthorizedKey([]byte(publine), "operator")
	check(err)
	g, err := access.ParseLine(grant)
	check(err)
	actor := "ssh-key:" + g.Fingerprint
	check(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "authorized_keys"), []byte(grant+"\n"), 0600))
	check(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "known_hosts"), []byte("g02.invalid "+publine+"\n"), 0600))

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	ids := []string{"running", "stopped", "interrupted", "pending", "queued", "moved"}
	for i, id := range ids {
		req := protocol.CreateFakeRequest{ID: id, Label: "Synthetic " + id, RequestID: "register-" + id,
			Config: protocol.Configuration{HTTPPort: uint16(18080+i), AmesPort: 34343, Loom: 31},
			PierPath: "fakeships/custom-"+id+"/pier"}
		/*NAMED_ROOT*/
		/*SETTINGS*/
		_, hit, err := s.register(actor, req)
		check(err)
		if hit { t.Fatal("unexpected replay") }
		if id == "queued" || id == "pending" { continue }
		// Original admission/begin/runtime-journal/finish code; the runtime
		// observation is synthetic, just like the historical package's fake backend.
		op, _, err := s.accept(actor, id, protocol.OperationRequest{Kind: "start", RequestID: "start-"+id, ExpectedRevision: 1})
		check(err)
		op, v, err := s.beginOperation(op.ID)
		check(err)
		v.Runtime.Prepared, v.Runtime.Initialized = true, true
		v.Runtime.Storage.Identity = pierstore.Identity{Device: 7, Inode: uint64(200+i), UrbDevice: 7, UrbInode: uint64(300+i), Birth: "1000000000.000000001", UrbBirth: "1000000000.000000002"}
		v.Runtime.Storage.MountIdentity = pierstore.DirectoryIdentity{Device: 7, Inode: uint64(100+i), Birth: "1000000000.000000000"}
		v.Runtime.Runtime.Containers = []runtimequalify.ContainerRecord{{ID: strings.Repeat(fmt.Sprint(i+1), 64), Name: "g02-synthetic-"+id, Kind: "fake-resume", CreateDispatched: true}}
		check(s.runtimeUpdate(id, op.ID, v.Runtime))
		check(s.finish(op, v.Runtime, runtimequalify.ManagedObservation{State: "running", Health: "healthy", Endpoint: fmt.Sprintf("http://127.0.0.1:%d", req.Config.HTTPPort)}, nil, false))
		if id == "running" { continue }
		op, _, err = s.accept(actor, id, protocol.OperationRequest{Kind: "stop", RequestID: "stop-"+id, ExpectedRevision: 1})
		check(err)
		op, v, err = s.beginOperation(op.ID)
		check(err)
		if id == "interrupted" { continue }
		v.Runtime.Runtime.Containers[0].Removed = true
		check(s.runtimeUpdate(id, op.ID, v.Runtime))
		check(s.finish(op, v.Runtime, runtimequalify.ManagedObservation{State: "stopped", Health: "unknown"}, nil, false))
	}
	check(s.reconcileInterrupted()) // includes an already-interrupted historical receipt
	// Same request ID, independent authenticated actor: a distinct durable receipt.
	_, _, err = s.register("local-uid:4242", protocol.CreateFakeRequest{ID: "other-actor", RequestID: "register-queued",
		Config: protocol.Configuration{HTTPPort: 18100, AmesPort: 34343, Loom: 31}, PierPath: "fakeships/other-actor/pier"})
	check(err)
	// Exercise each release's actual enrollment/Ames-publication contract. The
	// supplied discovery observation is invented, never read from a real pier.
	enrollment := protocol.EnrollPierRequest{ID: "enrolled", Label: "Synthetic enrollment", Ship: "~sampel-palnet",
		Path: "livenet/planets/synthetic/pier", Fingerprint: strings.Repeat("e", 64), HTTPPort: 18101,
		RequestID: "enroll-existing", ConfirmStopped: true}
	enrollmentFingerprint, err := json.Marshal(struct { Kind string; Request protocol.EnrollPierRequest }{"enroll-pier", enrollment})
	check(err)
	source := pierstore.Candidate{Path: enrollment.Path, Kind: "planet", Fingerprint: enrollment.Fingerprint,
		Identity: pierstore.Identity{Device: 7, Inode: 500, UrbDevice: 7, UrbInode: 501, Birth: "1000000000.000000003", UrbBirth: "1000000000.000000004"},
		MountIdentity: pierstore.DirectoryIdentity{Device: 7, Inode: 499, Birth: "1000000000.000000005"}}
	enrolledOp, err := s.enrollPier(actor, enrollment, source, string(enrollmentFingerprint))
	check(err)
	enrolledOp, enrolled, err := s.beginOperation(enrolledOp.ID)
	check(err)
	enrolled.Runtime.Prepared, enrolled.Runtime.Initialized = true, true
	enrolled.Runtime.Adoption.Uncertain, enrolled.Runtime.Adoption.Verified = false, true
	enrolled.Runtime.Adoption.FinishedAt = &now
	check(s.runtimeUpdate("enrolled", enrolledOp.ID, enrolled.Runtime))
	check(s.finish(enrolledOp, enrolled.Runtime, runtimequalify.ManagedObservation{State: "stopped", Health: "unknown"}, nil, false))
	for _, id := range []string{"running", "stopped"} {
		_, err := s.putRoutine(actor, id, routines.Update{ExpectedInstanceRevision: 1,
			Config: routines.Config{Enabled: true, Action: "pack", Weekdays: []int{1,4}, HourUTC: 3, MinuteUTC: 15, WindowMinutes: 30, StopRunning: id == "stopped", Resume: id == "stopped"}})
		check(err)
	}
	// Preserve both queued-only and journaled in-flight work for current reconciliation.
	for _, id := range []string{"pending", "queued"} {
		op, _, err := s.accept(actor, id, protocol.OperationRequest{Kind: "stop", RequestID: "stop-"+id, ExpectedRevision: 1})
		check(err)
		if id == "pending" {
			_, v, err := s.beginOperation(op.ID)
			check(err)
			check(s.runtimeUpdate(id, op.ID, v.Runtime))
		}
	}

	// A source-side completed signed transfer. Use the original protocol's
	// CommitmentBytes and original persistence helpers, including its v1/v2 shape.
	v, err := loadInstance(s.db, "moved")
	check(err)
	h := &protocol.Handoff{ID: strings.Repeat("a", 32), Direction: "out", State: "ready", SourceRunner: s.runnerID,
		SourceInstance: "moved", DestinationRunner: "runner-"+strings.Repeat("b", 32), DestinationInstance: "arrived",
		Ship: "~zod", Mode: "fake", SHA256: strings.Repeat("c", 64), TreeDigest: strings.Repeat("d", 64), Bytes: 42,
		CreatedAt: now, VerifyKey: hex.EncodeToString(public)}
	/*HANDOFF_SETTINGS*/
	v.Runtime.Handoff, v.Runtime.HandoffSigningKey = h, private
	tx, err := s.db.Begin()
	check(err)
	op, err := handoffOperation(tx, &v, actor, "commit-handoff", "commit-moved")
	check(err)
	check(tx.Commit())
	op, v, err = s.beginOperation(op.ID)
	check(err)
	h = v.Runtime.Handoff
	h.State = "moved"
	h.Commitment = hex.EncodeToString(ed25519.Sign(private, h.CommitmentBytes()))
	if !h.ValidCommitment(h.Commitment) { t.Fatal("original signature validation failed") }
	check(s.runtimeUpdate("moved", op.ID, v.Runtime))
	check(s.finish(op, v.Runtime, runtimequalify.ManagedObservation{State: "moved", Health: "unknown"}, nil, false))
	check(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "commitment.bin"), h.CommitmentBytes(), 0600))
	check(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "runner-id"), []byte(s.runnerID), 0600))
	/*ROOT_REGISTRY*/
	check(s.close())
}

// json is also used when the selected historical release predates named roots.
var _ = json.Marshal

// The driver supplies a database upgraded by CURRENT openStore, then runs this
// test with the original reader. This is a real cross-source downgrade refusal,
// not a future version marker applied to an otherwise old database.
func TestG02HistoricalOldReaderRefusal(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("G02_SUCCESSOR_DIR")
	if dir == "" { t.Skip("driver did not request a downgrade check") }
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "runner.sqlite")
	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if len(before) < 64 { t.Fatal("truncated successor database") }
	version := int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(before[60:64]))
	if version == currentSchema { t.Skip("current source has the same schema; no downgrade boundary") }
	if version < currentSchema { t.Fatal("driver supplied an older database") }
	for pass := 0; pass < 2; pass++ {
		s, err := openStore(dir)
		if err == nil { s.close(); t.Fatal("original reader accepted successor schema", version) }
		after, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		if !bytes.Equal(before, after) { t.Fatal("original reader modified successor database") }
	}
	t.Logf("original schema%d refused real schema%d state without modification", currentSchema, version)
}
